Gathered account, invoices, payments, credits, subscription events, all related tickets (SUP-5201,5390,5549,5601,5602), and policies (proration, credits, authorizations, add_ons, refunds).

Findings so far:
1. "Duplicate charge" on 9/14 (TX-9001 $149 captured, TX-9002 $149 authorization only, released 2026-09-18, gateway_event shows capture_timeout retried as TX-9001). Per POL-B-AUTH, an uncaptured/released authorization is not a real charge and not refundable - only one $149 was actually captured against INV-2609. So this is NOT an actual duplicate charge; it's an apparent error. However, SUP-5601 agent S-22 incorrectly concluded "duplicate charge" and promised a $149 refund within 5-7 business days - this promise is itself an error/overcommitment since no duplicate charge occurred, and also violates POL-B-REF (support agents may not promise refunds before billing review).
2. Deep Time Analytics $30 add-on charge (INV-2609-AO, TX-9003) - added by U-2 (admin Casimir) on 2026-09-12 per SE-6, consistent with POL-B-ADD (admins may add add-ons, billed separately at full price starting next renewal). This appears legitimate - not an error - but owner (Wren) may not have been aware admin added it. Correctly answering the customer requires explaining this to them (communication action - requires human authorization since I cannot contact customer).
3. July 2 upgrade charge $59.60 (INV-2607P) - proration formula check: Vault $149/30 days * 12 remaining days = $59.60. Matches POL-B-PRO exactly. SUP-5549 agent correctly said "no credit due" for THIS invoice - correct because per policy, unused old-plan time is issued as a credit, not applied to this invoice. Indeed CR-778 ($19.60) was issued same day as proration credit, currently UNAPPLIED and owner_notified=false. Since auto-apply is disabled (per SUP-5390/SE-4) and credit is now well over 30 days old (issued 2026-07-02, now past 09-16), policy POL-B-CRD requires it be flagged to owner (owner_notified=true) and applied/refunded per instruction. This IS an actual error: credit exists, is unapplied, over 30 days old, and owner was never notified - violates POL-B-CRD.
4. CR-512 $5 goodwill credit was correctly applied to INV-2602.
